meta.source: Reserve Bank of India (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Policy rates and auction results are final when announced. The Handbook restates a few effective dates between editions (newest edition wins, differences listed in rates-policy meta). Lending and deposit rates: each monthly release repeats the full history; the newest release wins.
meta.coverage: Every repo and reverse repo auction under the Liquidity Adjustment Facility since April 2001: bids received and accepted (number and amount), cut-off rates and tenors, fixed and variable rate
meta.note: RBI, Repo/Reverse Repo Auction under the Liquidity Adjustment Facility (DBIE report 1211, also 1217). Amounts converted from rupees to ₹ crore. The table prints each auction separately (numbered within the day); on days with several auctions of one kind (3436 day-facility cases) amounts and counts are summed and the cut-off rate and tenor are averaged, weighted by the amount accepted. 11646 cut-off rates printed on a 1e7 scale (7.00 as 70,000,000, the RBI's storage until August 2023) were divided by 1e7.
